battle.name: 歐加登戰爭
battle.theater: 埃塞俄比亞東南部歐加登地區
battle.brief: 歐加登戰爭於一九七七年七月爆發，埃塞俄比亞政府軍與索馬里軍隊在歐加登地區交鋒，邊境衝突其後擴大為正規地面戰爭。本條列舉的法軍制式雷管步槍（Percussion rifle）於一八四〇年列裝，是十九世紀步兵線列作戰使用的肩射長槍。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管步槍於一八四〇年列裝後，作為法國陸軍步兵單位的制式肩射長槍，位於步兵裝備序列的核心位置，主要承擔線列步兵的單兵射擊任務。

countries: 這場戰爭的直接交戰者是衣索比亞人民民主共和國與索馬利亞民主共和國，主要戰區在衣索比亞東南部的奧加登、哈拉爾、吉吉加、沙基索、戈德與貝爾一帶。索馬利亞自英屬索馬利蘭及奧加登邊境多路突入，古巴則派出軍事顧問、飛行員與技術人員協助其作戰；衣索比亞則由邊防部隊、內地增援部隊與裝甲突擊群投入。蘇聯雖未以公開地面部隊參戰，卻是兩軍重要的武器供應者與訓練夥伴，直接影響裝甲、炮兵和航空兵的運用。古巴人員屬索方作戰體系，蘇聯顧問則分別存在於兩軍之中，不能把兩種外部介入混為同一方向的參與。
countriesEn: The direct belligerents in this war were the People's Democratic Republic of Ethiopia and the Somali Democratic Republic, with the principal theater in Ogaden, Harar, Jijiga, Shakiso, Gode, and Bale in southeastern Ethiopia. Somalia attacked in several directions from British Somaliland and the Ogaden frontier, while Cuba supplied military advisers, pilots, and technicians to assist its operations. Ethiopia committed border troops, reinforcements from the interior, and armored strike groups. Although the Soviet Union did not openly deploy ground forces, it was an important supplier and training partner for both armies, directly influencing their armored, artillery, and aviation operations. Cuban personnel belonged to the Somali operational system, whereas Soviet advisers were present in both armies; these two forms of external involvement should not be treated as participation in the same direction.
people: 西亞德·巴雷是索馬利亞此次進攻的政治與最高軍事決策者，他批准在外交關係破裂後立即出兵，並把控制吉吉加、哈拉爾及切斷通往吉布地的鐵路交通列為主要目標。門吉斯圖·海萊·馬里安則在阿迪斯阿貝巴掌握全國軍政，初期倚靠被軍政整頓削弱而分散配置的邊防部隊，後來把國內增援集中到反攻方向。古巴飛行員直接駕駛索軍航空隊的MiG作戰，蘇聯顧問則分別協助兩軍訓練裝甲、炮兵與後勤。這些人員並非只提供象徵性的支援；開戰初期的空地協同、反攻階段的火力集中，以及補給線能否維持，都直接取決於他們與各級指揮官的合作。
peopleEn: Siad Barre was the political and supreme military decision-maker behind Somalia's invasion. He approved an immediate attack after diplomatic relations had broken down and made the seizure of Jijiga and Harar, together with cutting the railway to Djibouti, principal objectives. Mengistu Haile Mariam directed the national government from Addis Ababa. He initially relied on border troops weakened and dispersed by military reorganization, but later concentrated reinforcements from the interior for the counteroffensive. Cuban pilots flew MiGs directly in the Somali Air Force, while Soviet advisers trained the armored, artillery, and logistical systems of both armies. Their contribution was operational rather than symbolic: early air-ground coordination, the concentration of fire during the counteroffensive, and the survival of supply lines all depended on their cooperation with commanders at every level.
kits: 首批索軍突擊縱隊配備T-54型中型坦克、PT-76輕型坦克、BTR-60裝甲人員輸送車與BRDM-2偵察車，炮兵包括D-30式122毫米牽引榴炮及BM-21多管火箭砲，並以ZU-23式23毫米高射炮擔任野戰防空。索軍航空隊使用MiG-17與MiG-21，前者主要執行對地攻擊，後者掩護攻擊縱隊，古巴飛行員則操作其中相當數量。衣軍後續反攻可見M60A1戰車、蘇聯供應的T-55、BTR-60與BRDM-2，另有MiG-21、Su-7、Mi-8直升機和Ural-375六輪卡車。戰場所用主要彈藥包括T-55的100毫米炮彈、PT-76的76毫米炮彈，以及榴炮與火箭砲的122毫米高爆彈；上述型號在1977年均已列裝，並已交付交戰國作戰使用。
kitsEn: The initial Somali strike formations were equipped with T-54 medium tanks, PT-76 light tanks, BTR-60 armored personnel carriers, and BRDM-2 reconnaissance vehicles. Their artillery included D-30 122 mm towed howitzers and BM-21 multiple rocket launchers, while ZU-23 23 mm antiaircraft guns provided battlefield air defense. The Somali Air Force operated MiG-17 and MiG-21 fighters, the former mainly in a ground-attack role and the latter covering attacking columns; Cuban pilots operated a substantial portion of them. Ethiopian counteroffensive formations included M60A1 tanks, Soviet-supplied T-55s, BTR-60s, and BRDM-2s, together with MiG-21s, Su-7s, Mi-8 transport helicopters, and Ural-375 six-wheeled trucks. Principal ammunition included T-55 100 mm rounds, PT-76 76 mm rounds, and 122 mm high-explosive shells for howitzers and rocket launchers. All of these types had entered service before 1977 and had already been delivered to the belligerents.
tactics: 七月二十三日拂曉，索馬利亞沒有沿單一連續正面進攻，而是把兵力分為指向戈德、吉吉加、哈拉爾和貝爾的數個攻擊群。炮兵與MiG先做射擊準備，坦克沿公路和可通行地帶突進，步兵在兩翼展開，後方卡車攜帶燃料、122毫米炮彈、備用履帶與維修零件。部分裝甲越過鬆散邊防後直取交通點，使哈拉爾外圍與吉吉加方向迅速失衡。八月初衣軍零散反攻未能集中炮兵與戰車；八月九日哈拉爾戰役中，索軍集中戰車、步兵和古巴空戰支援，衣軍的奪城企圖失敗，市區控制權仍在索軍手中。轉折出現在八月中旬：衣軍停止零敲碎打，以MiG-21控制空域，Su-7打擊道路上的縱隊與陣地，再由裝甲、步兵和炮兵分路向哈拉爾會合；八月十二日前後反攻展開，八月十九日哈拉爾被奪回。之後，衣軍沿鐵路向西追擊沙基索、戈德，另由北面控制吉吉加，索軍的補給線與退路因持續拉長而失去完整性。
tacticsEn: At first light on 23 July, Somalia did not attack along a single continuous front. It divided its forces into several attack groups directed toward Gode, Jijiga, Harar, and Bale. Artillery and MiGs provided the initial fires, tanks advanced along roads and other usable ground, infantry deployed on both flanks, and trucks followed with fuel, 122 mm ammunition, spare tracks, and repair parts. Some armored formations passed through thinly held border positions and went directly for transport nodes, rapidly destabilizing the approaches to Harar and the Jijiga area. Ethiopian counterattacks in early August failed to concentrate artillery and armor. In the Battle of Harar on 9 August, the Somalis massed tanks, infantry, and Cuban air support, defeating the Ethiopian attempt to take the city and retaining control of the urban area. The turning point came in mid-August, when Ethiopia abandoned piecemeal attacks. MiG-21s gained control of the airspace, Su-7s struck columns and positions along the roads, and armor, infantry, and artillery converged on Harar from separate directions. The counteroffensive began around 12 August, and Harar was retaken on 19 August. Ethiopian forces then pursued along the railway toward Shakiso and Gode while another axis secured Jijiga from the north, leaving the Somali supply and withdrawal routes stretched beyond effective support.
data: 可核對的時間骨架是：一九七七年七月二十三日，索馬利亞開始全面進攻；七月底至八月初，其前鋒控制戈德與吉吉加並進抵哈拉爾；八月九日發生哈拉爾戰役；八月十二日前後衣軍展開有組織反攻；八月十九日奪回哈拉爾；八月下旬相繼重新控制沙基索、戈德和吉吉加；九月十五日雙方達成停火。由開戰至正式停火約五十四天，初始攻勢橫跨後世史料常稱約一千六百公里的邊界正面。主要交通軸是阿迪斯阿貝巴經德雷達瓦、哈拉爾、沙基索、戈德通往吉布地的鐵路，以及由吉布地延伸的公路；油料、炮彈、輪胎與戰車備件若不能抵達前沿，攻勢便會停滯。關於索軍首批兵力，後世常引用約三萬人及約二百輛戰車，但逐營數字與戰後損失核對不完整，只能視為概略估算。雙方傷亡數字沒有可靠統一總表，因此不列任何精確傷亡數。
dataEn: The verifiable chronology is as follows: Somalia began its full-scale invasion on 23 July 1977; by late July and early August its vanguard controlled Gode and Jijiga and reached Harar; the Battle of Harar occurred on 9 August; Ethiopia's organized counteroffensive began around 12 August; Harar was retaken on 19 August; Shakiso, Gode, and Jijiga were brought under Ethiopian control again during the latter half of August; and the two sides reached a ceasefire on 15 September. Approximately fifty-four days elapsed between the opening attack and the formal ceasefire. The initial offensive spanned a frontier front commonly described in later accounts as roughly 1,600 kilometers. Its principal axis was the railway from Addis Ababa through Dire Dawa, Harar, Shakiso, and Gode to Djibouti, together with the road leading inland from that port. Without fuel, ammunition, tires, and tank spares reaching the forward formations, an advance would stall. Later accounts often cite about 30,000 men and 200 tanks for the initial Somali force, but battalion-level figures and postwar loss reconciliations are incomplete, so these numbers can only be treated as rough estimates. No reliable unified casualty table survives for the two sides, and therefore no exact casualty total is given.
cause: 直接導火線是一九七七年六月衣索比亞封閉通往吉布地的鐵路，官方理由涉及安全，以及阻止武器經吉布地流向厄立特里亞武裝；這條鐵路同時是阿迪斯阿貝巴維持外部補給的重要通道。索馬利亞將關閉鐵路視為切斷其貿易與替代運輸線的行動，遂在七月二十二日與衣索比亞斷交，第二天開始進攻。更早的根源是奧加登邊界爭議：二戰後，前意大利管治的奧加登與英屬索馬利蘭一度由聯合國托管，一九五五年奧加登交由衣索比亞；索馬利亞始終不承認該安排，一九六四年的邊界衝突也未改變實際控制線。一九七四年軍政府上台後的軍事整頓、軍官清洗與對蘇聯、古巴的靠攏，使衣軍邊防體系一度削弱；西亞德·巴雷則判斷衣軍短時間內無法集中增援，因而選擇在外交衝突中立即動手。
causeEn: The immediate trigger was Ethiopia's closure of the railway to Djibouti in June 1977. The official rationale involved security and preventing weapons from reaching Eritrean armed organizations through Djibouti, while the line was also an essential channel for maintaining Addis Ababa's external supply. Somalia regarded the closure as an attempt to sever its trade and alternative transport route, broke diplomatic relations with Ethiopia on 22 July, and launched the invasion the following day. The deeper cause was the Ogaden boundary dispute. After the Second World War, the former Italian-administered Ogaden and British Somaliland came under United Nations trusteeship, and the Ogaden was transferred to Ethiopia in 1955. Somalia never accepted that settlement, while the 1964 border conflict left the practical boundary unchanged. The military reorganization and officer purges following the 1974 military government, together with closer alignment with the Soviet Union and Cuba, temporarily weakened Ethiopia's border forces. Siad Barre judged that Ethiopia could not concentrate reinforcements quickly and chose to act while diplomatic relations were breaking down.
impact: 最直接的戰略影響，是衣索比亞保住哈拉爾、德雷達瓦、吉吉加與通往吉布地的鐵路出口，索馬利亞未能把奧加登的軍事突破轉成對衣索比亞海運通道的永久切斷。衣軍由初期分散作戰轉向裝甲、炮兵與航空兵集中使用，戰術協調能力有所提高，但作戰體系也更深地依賴蘇聯供應的裝備、訓練與航空維修；這使德爾政府之後在軍政與戰略上進一步向蘇聯陣營靠攏。索軍則損失大量戰車、火炮、運輸車與航空兵力，前次進攻的信用及有限時間內突破縱深的可信度隨之下降，促使其尋求美國與沙烏地阿拉伯的替代援助，並在往後改善與蘇聯的關係。邊界爭議因此沒有因戰役結束而消失，但索馬利亞以常規軍正面推翻衣索比亞控制的嘗試已被證明難以重現。
impactEn: The most direct strategic effect was that Ethiopia retained Harar, Dire Dawa, Jijiga, and the railway outlet to Djibouti. Somalia could not convert its operational breakthrough in the Ogaden into a lasting disruption of Ethiopia's maritime supply route. The Ethiopian military moved from dispersed operations toward concentrated use of armor, artillery, and aviation, improving its tactical coordination, but it also became more dependent on Soviet equipment, training, and aviation maintenance. The Derg government consequently moved still closer to the Soviet camp in military and strategic policy. Somalia lost substantial quantities of tanks, artillery, trucks, and aircraft, and the credibility of immediately breaking deep into Ethiopia with conventional forces declined. It consequently sought alternative support from the United States and Saudi Arabia and later improved relations with the Soviet Union. The border dispute was not resolved, but Somalia's attempt to overturn Ethiopian control through a conventional frontal invasion had demonstrated the difficulty of repeating such an operation.
result: 到八月底，衣軍已把哈拉爾、吉吉加、沙基索和戈德全部收回，索軍作戰縱隊退向邊境，沒有占住德雷達瓦，也未能切斷阿迪斯阿貝巴通往吉布地的出口。衣軍在追至索馬利亞邊境後停止大規模越境攻擊，雙方於九月十五日達成停火，戰爭以衣索比亞保有全部奧加登行政控制、兩軍回復衝突前大體邊界局面告終。這不是索馬利亞國土被兼併，也不是兩軍遭到全滅；索方前期確實取得過戰術主動，卻因進攻方向過廣、後勤分散，以及反攻階段空域與火力集中而失去縱深。最終傷亡總數仍無可靠統一數字，不能以任何單一戰報宣稱精確損失。
resultEn: By the end of August, Ethiopian forces had recovered Harar, Jijiga, Shakiso, and Gode. Somali formations withdrew toward their border, having failed to seize Dire Dawa or sever Addis Ababa's outlet to Djibouti. Ethiopia halted large-scale offensive operations beyond the Somali frontier, and the two sides reached a ceasefire on 15 September. The war ended with Ethiopia retaining administrative control of the entire Ogaden and both armies returning to broadly the prewar territorial arrangement. This was neither an annexation of Somali territory nor the destruction of both armies. Somalia had achieved genuine tactical momentum during the opening phase, but overextended axes, dispersed logistics, and Ethiopian concentration of air superiority and firepower during the counteroffensive deprived it of operational depth. No reliable unified figure for total casualties exists, and no precise loss should be asserted from a single battlefield report.
